Position: Accountant (General)
Type: Full-time
Employer: Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd
Location: Laverton North VIC 3026
Salary: $110,000 p/a
About the Business:
Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd is a leading Australian meat processing, wholesale and export company specialising in the sourcing, processing, packaging and distribution of premium halal-certified meat products. The company supplies a wide range of fresh and frozen beef, lamb, mutton, goat and poultry products to domestic wholesalers, retailers, food service providers and international export markets. With a strong reputation for quality, reliability and strict adherence to Australian food safety and halal certification standards, Hilal Meat fosters a collaborative, values-driven workplace culture that emphasises integrity, continuous improvement, team support and a commitment to excellence in everything we do.
About the Position:
The Accountant (General) plays a vital role in supporting the financial integrity and strategic growth of Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd. Reporting to senior management, this position is responsible for managing core financial operations, delivering accurate reporting and analysis, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing insightful financial guidance to support informed business decisions in a dynamic meat processing and export environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Preparing and analysing financial statements including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements to provide a comprehensive view of the company’s financial performance.
Developing budgets and financial forecasts to assist with business planning and effective financial management.
Ensuring compliance with tax laws and regulations through the preparation and filing of tax returns, management of tax payments and handling of audits.
Conducting internal and external audits to verify the accuracy of financial records and maintain regulatory compliance.
Maintaining accurate financial records, including general ledger management, bank statement reconciliations and recording of financial transactions.
Analysing financial data to identify trends, assess performance and deliver insights to management for strategic decision-making.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
At least a bachelor or master degree or higher qualification in accounting (or at least five years of relevant experience)
A minimum of one year’s experience as an accountant.
Strong technical skills in financial reporting, budgeting, tax compliance, auditing, record-keeping and financial analysis, with proficiency in relevant accounting software.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Description
We are looking for a seasoned and highly capable Senior Cyber Security Analyst to join our team. In this key role, you will be responsible for protecting the organisation’s systems, networks, and data against evolving cyber threats. Your deep knowledge of cyber security frameworks, risk management, incident response, and operational security will be essential in maintaining our security posture and meeting regulatory requirements. This is a great opportunity to take the lead on critical cyber security initiatives while guiding and mentoring junior team members.
Responsibilities:
Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive cyber security strategies and initiatives
Conduct regular security risk assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend appropriate controls and countermeasures
Monitor and analyse security events, alerts, and logs to detect and respond to potential threats and breaches
Lead incident response efforts, including investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery, ensuring timely and effective resolution
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement secure infrastructure, systems, and applications
Conduct security assessments and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities
Provide guidance and support in the development and implementation of security policies, standards, and procedures
Stay up to date with the latest cyber security threats, trends, and technologies, and recommend proactive measures to enhance our security posture
Mentor and provide guidance to junior members of the cyber security team, promoting professional growth and development
Ensure compliance with relevant industry regulations and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR)
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Must have at least 2 years of proven work experience as a Cyber Security Analyst, with a focus on security operations, incident response, and risk assessment
In-depth knowledge of cyber security principles, frameworks, and best practices
Experience with security monitoring tools, SIEM solutions, and threat intelligence platforms
Familiarity with penetration testing methodologies, vulnerability assessment tools, and secure coding practices
Strong understanding of network security, firewall configuration, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection
Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automation and security tool integration
Familiarity with cloud security principles and technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure)
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex security issues and recommend effective solutions
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or GIAC certifications are highly desirable
Proven leadership skills, with the ability to lead and mentor junior team members
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply

ABA Automatic Gates & Doors is a Sydney-based, family-owned business specializing in pedestrian and vehicle access control solutions across Australia. We supply, install, and service automatic doors, sliding gates, and boom gates, featuring products from DITEC and ET. We serve both residential and commercial sectors. Our automatic doors and other entrances are sourced from Italian and overseas manufacturers, ensuring we don’t compromise on quality. This translates into reliability and longevity in both the products you buy and the service you receive from us.

We are seeking experienced and qualified MECHANICAL TECHNICIANS to join our team of hardworking professionals. In this role you will install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair automated gate systems, operators, and access control components. Key responsibilities include troubleshooting electrical/mechanical faults, replacing motors, sensors, and rollers, performing preventative maintenance, and ensuring systems meet safety regulations to ensure reliable entry/exit functionality.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Install new automated gate systems, operators, and peripheral access control devices
Perform functional tests to identify malfunctions in sensors, rollers, hinges, and motors
Diagnose failures, analyse performance, and implement efficient solutions to breakdowns and minimise downtime
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair hydraulic or mechanical faults in gate operators and hardware
Disassemble, assemble, observe, repair, test, collect data and prepare reports as tasks related to maintenance
Implement regular maintenance schedules to ensure optimal mechanical efficiency and longevity
Communicate with customers to explain maintenance and repair work being done
Provide recommendations for upgrades or replacements of gates and gate systems
Maintain accurate service records, repair logs, and safety documentation
Adhere to strict safety protocols and guidelines while performing work on gates and gate systems

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Strong understanding of mechanical systems, motors, and basic electrical systems
Previous work experience in gate installation and repair, commercial doors, or related mechanical field
Ability to diagnose complex issues with automation systems
Ability to read and interpret technical manuals and schematics
Proficiency in using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
Knowledge of safety procedures related to gate maintenance and repair
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Physically fit and able to lift heavy materials and equipment
Work outdoors in varying weather conditions

If you have the skills and experiences, we need for this position, please apply now.
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
